unverified_face.NE: Horizontal levels continue around the shaft; no vertical bonds added without direct evidence

unresolved_uppermost_course: Vertical streaks below the pyramid are insufficiently clear to distinguish every bond. No vertical seams are added in the uppermost band on any face.

joint_geometry.status: Estimated shallow recessed seams backed by a continuous solid tapered core; no see-through course gaps

surface_appearance: Existing authored Portland palette retained. Individual dark stains, pale replacement blocks and pitting still need a separate evidenced surface pass.
source_state: NW image 2011-07-30; SE image 2013-02-02; SW image 2013-07-18. No current live survey claimed.
inspection_method: Original photographs unchanged. Temporary rectified analysis boards show native photo pixels under a planar mapping at 200 pixels/metre. Manual joint picks are inverse-mapped to native pixels above. Source RGB is not embedded in model textures.
bed_height_uncertainty_scope: Approximate spread of photo registrations within the assumed metric envelope; 0.12 m does not bound absolute dimensional or ground-datum error.
